title: Pick the Middle Three
description: Return the middle three items, or the whole list when fewer than three exist.

off_by_one: The center has one position on either side.
Use the list length to locate the center.
A three-item result spans three consecutive positions.
Check lengths three, five, and seven.
unhandled_short_input: The requirement changes when fewer than three items exist.
Short lists should be returned unchanged.
Check the length before choosing a center.
Try zero, one, and two items.

explanations.exact_boundary: A list of exactly three items is already its middle three.
explanations.short_input: Lists shorter than three should be returned whole.
explanations.empty_list: The empty list has no middle items.
explanations.normal: The selected slice must be centered.
